applicability: Source-only qualification of the pinned Qwen3-Next CUDA-facing GDN caller
Mixed prefill/decode, packed/speculative metadata and state-row contracts

findings.direction: Treat every one-token row as decode in a mixed Qwen3-Next batch
findings.reason: A first one-token chunk can require the prefill route to mask recycled state; selecting a decode-only convolution for the whole mixed batch, or passing unre-based offsets to the prefill recurrence, misreads the source
findings.revisit_when: Use prior-state/prefill metadata as well as query length; identify the varlen forward convolution when non-speculative prefill rows exist

findings.direction: Infer the actual GDN branch from the requested backend
findings.reason: Selection inferred from package presence, default flags or symbol names does not establish the branch; a separate-conv rule does not generalize to every model/backend, and a source predicate is not hardware compatibility or speedup
findings.revisit_when: Trace the actual branch in the pinned source rather than the requested backend label

findings.direction: Equate batch index with cache row under reordering and speculation
findings.reason: Copying standalone-package cursor semantics into this API, preserving stale first-chunk state, or treating convolution and recurrent state as attention KV all break the state-row contract
findings.revisit_when: Track reordered state rows and speculative progress explicitly; account for both state writes

findings.direction: Assert a model-to-HF binding from source reading alone
findings.reason: Inventing a model-to-HF implementation mapping, prescribing an unverified installation, or asserting numeric correctness, hardware support or speedup all exceed what source classification establishes
findings.revisit_when: Keep the binding unproven until an identified caller is verified; native execution here is not_run

limitations: No concrete HF binding, external implementation equivalence, hardware compatibility or performance claim
Physical state allocation, release and recycling outside the readset
